REQ-2.2 waited for a visible heading named BookStack User, but the generated navigation renders the nickname as span.user-chip and the homepage heading remains BookStack.

The backend contains the relevant create, update, page, draft, favorite, and navigation data paths; the supplied failures are not evidence of a runner-wide startup outage.
